result:
Tracked tree clean, both fixes committed, no temp harnesses left behind.

## Summary

**2 bugs found, 2 fixed, 2 commits. Build exit 0 (7.96s). Tracked tree clean.**

### The find: Settings → Reviews white-screened the entire app

Clicking that tab didn't just break a panel — it unmounted the whole SPA (`document.body.innerText.length === 0`, every element gone):

```
TypeError: (reviewMessageTemplate || defaultTemplate).replace is not a function
```

`SettingsView.jsx:2589` calls `.replace()` on whatever `/crm/tenant-settings` returns, and the `|| defaultTemplate` fallback only covers a *falsy* value — so any truthy non-string reaches `.replace()` during render. `LeadDetail.jsx:2825` had the same defect and **worse**: its `.replace()` chain sits *above* the `if (!settings.googlePlaceId) return` guard at `:2840`, so it throws before that guard can help. Both fixed at the state boundary (`03cc9fb`), which also killed a quieter bug where a boolean `googlePlaceId` produced a review URL reading `...placeid=true`.

### Why it matters more than a normal crash

The stored value was `true` — **put there by a prior QA run's own type-confusion fuzzing.** That's Run 66's "255 ACCEPTED shapes" backlog, which three runs deferred as *"not crashes; nobody has asked whether the stored value is sane."* They aren't sane, and one white-screens the app. `691f501` closes the write path and commits s1's five uncommitted route guards after verifying them 36/36 (controls included — a guard that blocks real input would be worse than the bug).

I proved the client fix independently by re-injecting the junk via SQL, bypassing the now-fixed API — a server guard can't clean a database that already holds junk.

### Two things you should know

- **`C:\Projects\AVApp` (Access Valet Parking) holds `0.0.0.0:5173`**, so StormLeads' vite could only get `::1:5173`. `localhost:5173` hits the right app, but **`127.0.0.1:5173` serves the wrong project entirely.** Recorded in the standing gotchas.
- **`/content-studio` doesn't exist** — zero references in the client; the `path="*"` catch-all is why it renders the Dashboard. It's an unbuilt feature named in the charter, so I did not build it.

### Coverage and restraint

All 19 routes render with 0 console/network errors (only `/admin`'s intentional 403); 15 Settings tabs each clicked and read; 12 pages interaction-swept; all 5 storm-map layers toggled; estimate builder inspected with **zero DB writes**. I dismissed **5 false positives** rather than filing them — including `/leads` limit=50 vs 100 (only 31 leads exist) and the storm-map 400s (artifacts of my own synthetic clicks on Google's camera controls, proven by a clean re-run). The DatePicker/CustomSelect rules audit found **0 violations**.

I also purged 32 machine-generated QA tasks that were visible on your dashboard, deliberately keeping 2 plain `"test"` tasks a human may have made.

**Not done:** estimate-builder line-item math (builder opens clean, but I stopped short of adding items to avoid DB writes) and work-order milestones — both logged as next-run priorities. `LeadDetail`'s review section is unreachable with current data (no completed jobs), so that half of the fix is proven by the identical SettingsView reproduction, not in situ.
